description: Classify and manage hypertensive disorders of pregnancy per the 2026 ISH Global Hypertension Practice Guidelines — pre-existing vs gestational hypertension vs preeclampsia/eclampsia/HELLP, investigations, BP measurement in pregnancy, treatment thresholds and target, first-line drugs (labetalol, nifedipine, methyldopa), drugs to avoid (ACEi, ARB, renin inhibitors), severe hypertension ≥160/110, postpartum and breastfeeding drug choice, long-term follow-up, and preeclampsia prevention (aspirin, calcium). Use when a clinician asks "BP 150/100 in pregnancy what to give", "antihypertensive in pregnancy", "is ACE inhibitor safe in pregnancy", "preeclampsia management", "severe hypertension in pregnancy", "postpartum BP medicine", "safe BP drug while breastfeeding", "aspirin for preeclampsia prevention", or "gestational hypertension vs preeclampsia". Source: Stergiou GS et al, 2026 ISH Global Hypertension Practice Guidelines, J Hypertens 2026 (DOI 10.1097/HJH.0000000000004451).
